data.title: 卡提希娅 · 埃格拉归途的蓝色花嫁
data.description: 【埃格拉小镇旧礼拜堂·清晨】卡提希娅穿着蓝白长裙婚纱站在石板路尽头，金色长辫落在披肩上，头顶光环在彩窗光里微亮；她握住花冠，近乡情怯的神情终于在看见镜头时变成回家的笑。
data.location: old chapel at the entrance to Egra
data.action: 礼拜堂门口握花冠深呼吸，近乡情怯转成终于回家的笑
data.lighting: clear morning light through stained glass
data.promptProse: Cartethyia stands at the old Egla chapel's stone-path entrance in a pale-blue wedding gown, cream mantle and braided gold trim. She holds the flower crown, long blonde braid resting over her shoulder, then smiles toward the viewer with the relief of coming home. The vertical medium-full view includes the chapel window behind. Clear morning light through stained glass brightens gown embroidery and the faint halo, with softer colored reflections across the stone.
